economy.summary: His campaign site says he supports raising the minimum wage, protecting the Prevailing Wage Act, and supporting small businesses, and that he wants to reduce inflation.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, prevailing wage, small businesses; reducing inflation.

taxes.summary: His campaign site says he advocates for property-tax relief for senior citizens.
taxes.short: Advocates property-tax relief for senior citizens.

abortion.summary: His campaign site says he will fight to guarantee that all women have the right to make health care decisions for themselves.
abortion.short: Says women have right to make own health care decisions.

education.summary: His campaign site says every child deserves an equal opportunity and calls fair funding vital to all school districts; he also supports universal Pre-K and an expansion of early childhood education.
education.short: Supports fair school funding, universal Pre-K, early childhood expansion.

healthcare.summary: His campaign site says every Pennsylvanian deserves affordable, accessible, and quality health care, and that he will stand up against insurance special interests he says care more about profits than providing quality care.
healthcare.short: Says all deserve affordable care; opposes insurance special interests.

energy.summary: Cosponsored House Bill 2496 in 2026, which would let municipalities pause data center project applications for up to 180 days while they write or revise land-use ordinances; he said local governments deserve the ability to make informed decisions about major projects.
energy.short: Cosponsored bill letting municipalities pause data center applications.

guns.summary: Voted for House Bill 714 in May 2023, legislation widely described as expanding background-check requirements to private sales and transfers of long guns; the bill passed the House 109-92.
guns.short: Voted for bill expanding background checks to long-gun sales.
